thread:
alex: Heads-up — release cutoff is tomorrow 15:00 UTC. We need the console + docs updates landed and SDK docs regenerated before cutoff. Can folks owning those pieces confirm status?

maria: I'm on docs. I have the content changes ready in docs-site branch `release/1.12.0-docs`. I'll run a full build tonight and push artifacts. Do you want a version bump in the changelog or shall I just add a short note?

sam: Yes please bump to 1.12.0 in the changelog (semver patch). Also add a short line under "Highlights" — we need the console feature mentioned. I'm tagging the release notes PR in a bit.

jin: Console UI change PR opened: https://git.example.com/redwood/console/pulls/482 — needs a quick review and a backport to `release/1.12` if it gets merged. I've left the backport branch `bp/console-482` ready. CI is green locally but flaky on e2e.

leo: I'll take the review for the console PR this afternoon. If the e2e flakes, we can run the specific test locally: ```yarn test e2e console-filters --grep "should persist filter"```

maria: Docs build kicked off: CI shows success so far. docs-bot: can you post the artifact link once published?

docs-bot: Artifact published: https://artifacts.example.com/docs/release-1.12.0/docs-site.tar.gz (md5: 9f7a3b...). Deploy target set to staging.

alex: Thanks. One more ask: SDK docs regen — @maria are you able to run the SDK docs script or do you need the SDK team to do it? Command we usually run: 
```
# from sdk repo
make docs-build
./scripts/publish-docs.sh --target release/1.12.0
```

maria: I can run it but I'll need the SDK artifact (client package) built and uploaded. @sam can you confirm the SDK CI will publish the tarball to the internal registry by EOD?

sam: Confirmed — SDK CI will publish artifact `redwood-sdk@1.12.0` to our internal registry at 21:00 UTC. I'll add a note to the release checklist.

deploy-bot: CI: all checks passed for branches: release/1.12.0-docs, bp/console-482. No blocking alerts.

jin: Quick note — if we need a hotfix after cutoff, let's agree on the policy: only critical regressions get cherry-picks to `release/1.12` and we tag them with `hotfix/*`. Otherwise hold to next patch.

alex: Agreed. For canary window, let's do a staggered deploy tomorrow 16:00-18:00 UTC: staging -> canary (5%) -> full. @maria please run docs deploy to canary after staging validation. Sam will toggle canary.

maria: Roger. I'll schedule the docs deploy for 16:15 UTC and post the staging smoke checklist here.

leo: I'll run the smoke tests once docs are on canary and post results.

alex: Perfect. Small reminder — bump the package version in `package.yaml` before merging docs PR: `yq -i '.version="1.12.0"' package.yaml` and include the changelog entry under `docs/CHANGELOG.md`. :thumbsup:

maria: Will do. I'll ping here when the SDK docs publish is complete.

sam: Thanks all — I'll update the release checklist and ping on any blockers.

alex: Great work, team. Let's keep this thread for last-minute rollout notes.
